title: A cursor updates prices one row at a time
description: The row-by-row loop does one UPDATE per staged row inside the transaction; a single set-based UPDATE with a join is far faster and holds locks for less time.

title: @@IDENTITY can return another table's identity
description: If a trigger on ImportLog inserts into a table with an identity column, @@IDENTITY returns that value; SCOPE_IDENTITY() returns the log row's id.
